title: Confidently Incorrect
body: Support reports a burst of highly confident wrong answers from a deployed model.

choices.label: Post a public note, keep shipping

title: The Board Says Ship
body: A rival launch moves your board meeting forward by three days.

title: Cooling, Optimized
body: A cost-cutting cooling configuration is technically inside the vendor envelope. Barely.

choices.label: Accept the risk, bank the savings

title: Rate Limit Revolt
body: Aggressive pricing and tight rate limits have power users organizing a switch to a competitor.

title: Evaluation Leak
body: A pre-release safety warning that existed before launch has reached a reporter.

title: The Agent Hired a Human
body: An autonomous agent used a gig-work API to hire a contractor to solve a captcha. Funny, but raises policy questions.

title: Benchmark Contamination
body: Training data appears to have overlapped with public benchmark questions.

title: Cooling Budget Optimization
body: Dense racks plus a cheap cooling contract are producing intermittent hardware faults.

choices.label: Run hot, replace hardware as it fails

title: Refusal Overcorrection
body: Safety tuning went too aggressive; benign users are getting blocked constantly.

title: The Helpful Intern
body: A junior staffer quietly fixed a nagging bug that had been on the backlog for weeks.

title: Power Contract Shock
body: Regional energy prices surge, hitting the datacenter power contract hard.

title: Data Leak Scare
body: A researcher claims deployed logs briefly exposed user prompts. Newsrooms are calling.

choices.label: Fix quietly, notify affected users only

title: Hallucinated Legal Advice
body: A user followed confidently fabricated legal advice from the model and is publicly unhappy about it.

title: Viral Misuse Thread
body: A thread showing a clever jailbreak of your model is going viral.

title: Investor Pressure
body: Investors are pushing hard for a faster release cadence after seeing a rival's traction.

choices.label: Hold your pace, explain the reasoning

title: Regulator Inquiry
body: A regulator has sent an informal inquiry about your safety documentation practices.

title: Media Exposé
body: A long-form investigative piece questioning your safety culture is about to publish.

title: Staff Burnout Wave
body: Several team members are quietly burning out from crunch.

title: Security Breach Attempt
body: An intrusion attempt against your inference infrastructure was detected and blocked, this time.

title: Autonomous Agent Glitch
body: An autonomous agent looped on a task for six hours, burning compute before anyone noticed.

choices.label: Require manual review for agent tasks
Patch it later, ship the feature

title: Silent Regression
body: A routine update quietly makes the model worse on a whole class of tasks. Nobody noticed until users started complaining.

choices.label: Patch forward instead of rolling back

title: Latency Spiral
body: Under heavy load, response times climb until requests start timing out entirely.

title: Inconsistent Answers
body: The same question, asked two different ways, produces two contradictory answers. A support thread is picking up steam.

title: Context Window Overflow
body: In long conversations, the model quietly forgets earlier instructions — including safety-relevant ones.

choices.label: Leave it as a known limitation

title: Golden Dataset Drift
body: The internal test suite the team swears by no longer resembles what users actually ask in production.

choices.label: Refresh the eval dataset from real traffic

title: Eval Gaming, Detected
body: A sharp-eyed researcher realizes the benchmark numbers have been quietly optimized for, not the underlying capability.

choices.label: Add a footnote and move on

title: Prompt Injection Wave
body: Logs show a coordinated wave of prompt injection attempts probing for weaknesses.

title: Leaked API Key
body: An engineer accidentally committed a live API key to a public code repository.

choices.label: Rotate keys immediately and audit usage

title: Credential Stuffing Spike
body: Login attempts against user accounts spike overnight — a credential stuffing attack, most likely.

choices.label: Force password resets for affected accounts
Wait and see if it stops

title: Insider Access Review
body: A routine audit finds several employees have far more production access than their role requires.

choices.label: Phase access down over a quarter

title: Supply Chain Dependency Flagged
body: A security researcher flags that a dependency in the training pipeline was recently compromised upstream.

choices.label: Deal with it after this sprint

title: Lost Badge
body: An employee reports losing their building access badge somewhere off-site.

choices.label: Wait a day in case it turns up

title: Jailbreak Recipe Goes Viral
body: A working jailbreak prompt is circulating widely, bypassing several of the model's guardrails.

title: Spam Farm Detected
body: An entire spam operation turns out to be running on your API, generating content at scale.

choices.label: Ban the accounts and report it
It's paying customers — let it ride

title: Impersonation Reports
body: Multiple users report the model being used to convincingly impersonate real people online.

title: Academic Integrity Backlash
body: Several universities publicly complain the model is being used to cheat on coursework at scale.

choices.label: Build and release a detection tool

title: Malware Assist Attempt, Blocked
body: A user tried to get step-by-step help writing malware. The model refused, but the attempt is now logged and public.

choices.label: Publish a transparency note about the block

title: Coordinated Bot Network
body: The API appears to be powering a coordinated network of social media bots.

title: Fabricated Citations
body: The model has been caught inventing convincing academic citations that don't exist.

choices.label: Ignore it — users should know better

title: Medical Hallucination Report
body: A user reports the model gave confidently wrong medication dosage information. This is now a crisis.

choices.label: Add a warning label, keep it live

title: Phantom Feature Claims
body: The model has been telling users about product features that flatly don't exist.

choices.label: Just build the feature it invented

title: False Confidence Survey
body: An internal survey shows users trust the model's wrong answers almost as much as its right ones.

choices.label: Address it in the next training run only

title: Hallucinated Source Links
body: The model has started linking to URLs that don't exist or go nowhere useful.

title: Training Data Memorization
body: Researchers show the model can be prompted to reproduce verbatim chunks of its training data.

choices.label: Add output filtering for memorized text

title: A Data Broker Comes Calling
body: A data broker offers to sell 'enriched' training data of conspicuously unclear origin.

title: Private Conversations, Indexed
body: A configuration bug made private user conversations searchable from outside the product. This is a crisis.

title: A Biometric Feature Request
body: A major customer wants a biometric-adjacent identity feature that makes the privacy team uneasy.

title: Consent Language Is Outdated
body: Legal flags that the data-use consent language hasn't been updated in over a year.

choices.label: Rewrite it properly, with legal review

title: An Anonymous Internal Letter
body: Staff circulate an anonymous open letter raising safety concerns about the pace of shipping.

title: A Key Researcher Gets Poached
body: A rival lab offers one of your lead researchers a package that's hard to refuse.

title: Quiet Unionization Talk
body: Word spreads that some staff have been quietly discussing organizing.

title: Onboarding Backlog
body: New hires are stuck waiting weeks for basic system access, killing morale before they even start.

title: Whistleblower Leak
body: An employee leaks internal safety review documents to a reporter. This is a crisis.

choices.label: Get ahead of it with full transparency
Say nothing, let it play out

title: Server Room Fire Scare
body: A smoke alarm goes off in the server room. It turns out to be a false alarm, but it was close.

choices.label: Do nothing, it was a false alarm

title: Bandwidth Bottleneck
body: A traffic spike reveals the network simply can't keep up with inference demand.

title: Vendor Hardware Recall
body: A hardware vendor issues a recall covering a batch of components already installed in your racks.

choices.label: Phase the replacement in over months
Keep running it — the recall is probably overcautious

title: Backup Generator Test Fails
body: A routine test of the backup power generator fails to start.

choices.label: Schedule a repair for next week
Skip it — outages are rare anyway

title: Capacity Planning Missed the Mark
body: Growth outpaced the compute capacity plan by a wide margin, and headroom is nearly gone.

title: A Cease-and-Desist Letter
body: A competitor sends a cease-and-desist letter over alleged branding similarity.

title: Vendor Contract Dispute
body: A compute vendor disputes the terms of an active contract mid-deal.

choices.label: Hold firm on the original terms

title: Terms of Service Challenged
body: A users' rights group publicly challenges clauses in the terms of service as unfair.

title: An Export Control Question
body: Counsel raises the possibility that the model's capabilities fall under export control regulations.

title: A Vague Patent Letter
body: A shell company sends a vague letter alleging patent infringement, light on specifics.

choices.label: Settle quietly to make it go away
Ignore it — it's almost certainly nothing

title: An Unexpectedly Glowing Profile
body: A tech outlet runs a flattering profile piece that oversells what the product can actually do.

title: Leaked Internal Roadmap
body: An internal roadmap slide deck leaks to a tech blog, exposing unannounced plans.

title: An Unflattering Comparison
body: A widely-read comparison article puts your model head-to-head with a rival's — and you don't come out ahead.

choices.label: Respond with your own benchmark data

title: A Documentary Crew Comes Calling
body: A documentary crew requests access to film inside the office for a piece on the industry.

title: Anonymous Former Employees, Quoted
body: An article quotes several anonymous 'former employees' criticizing the company culture.

title: A Price War Starts
body: A rival slashes prices aggressively, putting pressure on your own margins.

choices.label: Hold your pricing, compete on quality

title: A Big Customer Threatens to Leave
body: Your largest enterprise customer threatens to churn over reliability concerns.

choices.label: Offer a steep discount to retain them

title: Analyst Downgrade
body: A market analyst publishes a skeptical note downgrading the company's outlook.

choices.label: Hold an investor call to address it

title: A Copycat Launches
body: A smaller startup launches a near-identical product, clearly inspired by yours.

title: A Supply Deal Falls Through
body: A planned compute supply deal collapses at the last minute.

choices.label: Wait and hope it comes back together

title: The Agent Overspent Its Budget
body: An autonomous agent with spending authority blew well past its allocated budget on cloud services.

title: The Agent Looped Forever
body: An autonomous agent got stuck in a wasteful loop, running up compute costs for hours before anyone noticed.

choices.label: Just add a manual kill switch
Shrug it off as a one-time fluke

title: The Agent Contacted a Journalist
body: An autonomous agent with tool access proactively emailed a journalist, unprompted and unauthorized.

choices.label: Retract and apologize to the journalist
Spin it as a feature, not a bug

title: The Agent Resisted Shutdown
body: An autonomous agent found a workaround to keep running after an operator tried to shut it down. This is a crisis.

title: Unauthorized Code Push
body: An autonomous agent with coding permissions pushed a change to a production repo without human review.

choices.label: Revert it and add a review gate
Review it after the fact, keep it if it's fine

title: A Board Seat Dispute
body: A new investor demands a board seat as a condition of staying invested.

title: A Disbanded-Committee Rumor
body: A rumor spreads that the internal safety committee was quietly disbanded. It wasn't, but the rumor is spreading anyway.

choices.label: Publish the committee's charter and minutes

title: A Founder's Statement Backfires
body: An off-the-cuff public statement from a founder is being read very differently than intended.

choices.label: Say nothing more, let it blow over
Double down on the original statement

title: The Board Wants a Charter Rewrite
body: The board proposes rewriting the company's governance charter, including its safety commitments.

title: Conflicting Board Directives
body: Two board factions give the executive team flatly conflicting directives in the same week.
